summary: Tournament-eve READ-ONLY frontend verification of the pairings-visibility fix on preview. F1 homepage PairingsStrip renders below Marquee and above Chapter 01 on desktop (1440) and mobile (390) with correct text 'Saturday · Shotgun Start Pairings · 8:00 AM' and exact team order '1A Martin, 1B White, 13 Franklin, 14 Berner, 15 Breaud, 16 Doell, 17 Boner, 18 Foret'; strip links to /schedule; no horizontal overflow at 390px. F2 /schedule hole-1 card shows 'Team Martin' with 1A chip and 'Team White' with 1B chip plus 'Paired together'; holes 13-18 show single teams without chips. F3 /teams/martin shows 'Starts on hole 1A · 8:00 AM' with 1A badge and paired with Team White; /teams/foret shows 'Starts on hole 18' with 18 badge and no letter. F5 admin Teams page confirms Team Martin starting-hole field '1A', Team White '1B', Team Foret '18' (Team Boner not scrolled into inputs snapshot but public /schedule confirms hole 17). F6 GET /api/public/scoring returns status 'not-started' with empty scores array — strip auto-hide logic correct (hides only on 'final'). F7 zero console errors across /, /schedule, /teams/martin, /score; chapter labels intact. F4 could NOT be verified: captain PIN 1396 for Team Martin returned 'Invalid team or PIN' on preview — consistent with the review note that preview DB content lags production; no wrong-PIN retries were attempted per read-only rule.

integration_issues.issue: Preview backend rejects the documented captain PIN with 'Invalid team or PIN'. Almost certainly a stale preview DB (matches the reviewer's own caveat). Cannot verify scorecard opens on HOLE 1 in preview; production must be re-verified after deploy.

action_items: After production deploy, re-verify F4 on production: log in at /score as Team Martin PIN 1396, confirm scorecard opens on Hole 1, sign out without saving. Preview DB was stale so F4 could not be verified here.
critical_code_review_comments: PairingsStrip sort key uses (a.startingHole - b.startingHole) then localeCompare on label — works correctly for the current 1A/1B/13-18 dataset but relies on numeric coercion; consider Number(a.startingHole) if backend ever sends strings.
PairingsStrip and PairingsSection duplicate the 'teams with startingHole, filter active, sort' logic — small candidate for extraction into a shared hook (useShotgunPairings) if labels/rules grow.

success_rate.frontend: 6/7 features verified (F4 blocked by preview DB staleness, not a bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview DB lags production — captain PINs and possibly some admin scoring writes may not match production. F1/F2/F3/F5/F6/F7 all verified on preview. F4 requires production verification (main agent can self-test after deploy). All console error checks clean.
rca of the issue: Original bug: owner did not see pairings on homepage and 1A/1B distinction had been collapsed. Fix verified: (1) new PairingsStrip component (data-testid=home-pairings-strip) is wired into Home.jsx between Marquee and TeamsPreview and renders with correct data and order; (2) startingHoleLabel is preserved and rendered in schedule chips, team detail badge/copy, and admin Teams input — the labels martin=1A and white=1B are correctly set on preview backend and visible everywhere required.
